description: Full IRS EO BMF record for one organization by EIN, with the coded fields (subsection, foundation status, deductibility, EO status, ruling date) decoded to human-readable labels. Includes address, NTEE code, and the most recent reported asset/income/revenue figures.

ein.description: Employer Identification Number (EIN). Accepts 9 digits with or without a dash, e.g. "13-1837418" or "131837418".
